basis: GameStop’s December 6 earnings release was the earliest qualifying issuer communication found. Its consolidated GAAP statement of operations reports net sales of $1,078.3 million for the 13 weeks ended October 28, 2023, versus $1,186.4 million for the 13 weeks ended October 29, 2022. Sales fell 9.1% and were below the $1,127.08 million threshold. The earlier releases, filings, and public remarks searched yielded no quarter-specific consolidated sales forecast or preliminary result that met the threshold.

coverage.detail: December 7, 2022. The original fiscal Q3 2022 GAAP table reports $1,186.4 million of net sales, matching the comparative in the fiscal Q3 2023 release. Both use the reported consolidated perimeter.
June 7, 2023, preceding earnings cycle. The Q1 release discussed expected Q2 transition charges, gave no Q3 net-sales outlook, and said GameStop would hold no earnings call that day.
June 7. The companion exhibit announced Ryan Cohen’s election as executive chairman and the former CEO’s termination. It contained no sales forecast.
June 21. The 8-K covering the June 15 shareholder meeting reported voting matters under Item 5.07 and included no investor presentation or guidance exhibit.
July 27. The CFO resignation announcement named an interim principal financial officer and contained no sales outlook.

September 6, immediately previous earnings release. GameStop reported Q2 net sales of $1,163.8 million versus $1,136.0 million, gave no numeric Q3 sales guidance, and said it would hold no earnings call that day.
The Q2 Form 10-Q discussed reported sales and seasonality without giving an upper bound for fiscal Q3 2023 consolidated sales.
September 28. The intervening 8-K exhibit announced Cohen’s appointment as president and CEO and his compensation terms. It supplied no preliminary results or guidance.

September 28. Cohen’s employee memo, reproduced in the article, discussed slower software revenue as a possible business scenario. It specified neither a fiscal quarter nor a numeric consolidated sales bound.
November 22. GameStop’s own wire announcement scheduled Q3 results for after market close on December 6. It disclosed no sales figure or range.
December 6. The issuer’s IR copy gives the publication date and the consolidated GAAP table with both 13-week net-sales figures.
The Q3 Form 10-Q independently confirms a $108.1 million, or 9.1%, year-over-year decrease in reported quarterly net sales.

publication_date_evidence: GameStop’s IR page displays December 6, 2023. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same dateline and states that GameStop released the results that day. The November 22 issuer notice had scheduled publication for December 6 after market close.
